title: Does RDW add grip-strength prediction beyond flexible routine measures? A two-cycle NHANES test
abstract: Adding sex-specific nonlinear RDW terms did not meet the registered incremental grip-prediction criterion: source grouped-CV MSE gain -1.122817, second-cycle gain 0.372636 kg² (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-6.644499,4.930078]). No independent non-NHANES validation was completed. Complete-case adults aged≥60: source n=1193, target n=1363. Target baseline/augmented MSE=116.157181/115.784546 kg². RDW association is already known; this retrospective test evaluates incremental prediction, not biomarker novelty.
